questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. This sign means no right turns are allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction is ahead. Be careful and watch for construction workers and equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the highway ahead splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road ahead curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs indicate a no passing zone. You cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about dangerous objects or areas you should avoid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use this lane to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering. A detour sign tells you to take an alternate route because the main road is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead and you may need to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the fastest legal speed for the road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that buggies may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones and hazards. This sign tells you that the right lane ahead is closed due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs notify drivers of unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign warns you to slow down and drive carefully because the road ahead is under construction or maintenance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic flow and display rules you must follow. This sign is posted at traffic lights where turning right on red is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign marks either a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black and prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a lane is ending and you need to merge safely with other traffic.
